connector.name: Mailsnail
connector.registryDescription: Send USPS letters, postcards & certified mail from any agent. No signup; pay-per-piece via Stripe.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mailsnail. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the iancollins27 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
env.description: Where to mail from: 'managed' (default, no signup, pay-per-piece via Stripe), 'click2mail' (BYO account), or 'lob' (BYO key).

env.name: MAIL_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Hosted Mailsnail backend. Required when MAIL_PROVIDER=managed.

env.name: CLICK2MAIL_USERNAME
env.description: Click2Mail account username. Required when MAIL_PROVIDER=click2mail.

env.name: CLICK2MAIL_PASSWORD
env.description: Click2Mail account password. Required when MAIL_PROVIDER=click2mail.

env.name: LOB_API_KEY
env.description: Lob API key. Required when MAIL_PROVIDER=lob. test_* is free; live_* actually mails.

env.name: MAIL_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE
env.description: Set to '1' to actually mail in BYOK modes. Default '0' is dry-run.

env.name: MAIL_MCP_SPEND_CAP_USD
env.description: Per-session estimated spend cap. Server refuses sends past this.
